name: @aos/knowledge-policy
description: AOS Enterprise Knowledge Policy Platform — defines, validates, evaluates, and enforces every policy governing Knowledge Assets inside AOS: policy lifecycle, policy rules, policy evaluation, policy resolution, policy assignment, policy scope, policy conditions, policy actions, policy metadata, policy registry, policy statistics, and policy audit metadata only. No retrieval, no runtime, no synchronization, no versioning, no indexing, no search, no embedding, no vector search, no RAG, no AI, no LLM, no workflow, no agent, no memory.
